$comment: Status: In Progress — tenantId GAP unresolved in current implementation. See artifact-store-spec.md.
title: ArtifactRef
description: Reference to an immutable, content-addressed artifact stored in DVT+ artifact storage.

tenantId.description: Tenant scope. GAP: not present in current ArtifactRef type in @dvt/contracts. Required for INV-ART-003 compliance.
tenantId.$comment: IMPLEMENTATION GAP — packages/@dvt/contracts/src/types/artifacts.ts does not include tenantId. Must be added.

artifactHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of artifact content (content-addressable key). 64 lowercase hex characters.

uri.description: Storage URI. Current adapters use scheme-specific format (s3://, file://, mem://, noop://). Target: artifact://{tenantId}/{kind}/{sha256}.

encoding.description: Character encoding. MUST be utf-8. Omit for binary artifacts.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC expiry timestamp. GAP: field declared in type but TTL is not enforced by any storage adapter or cleanup job.

implementationGaps.$comment: Known gaps vs. current code in packages/@dvt/contracts/src/types/artifacts.ts: (1) tenantId field absent — violates INV-ART-003; (2) artifactHash is optional (sha256?) in code, required here; (3) kind uses open string in code, enum enforced here; (4) expiresAt declared but no TTL enforcement exists; (5) schemaVersion field does not exist in current ArtifactRef type.
